relations.subject: David Dean Shulman
relations.evidence: he enrolled at Hebrew University of Jerusalem. He graduated in 1971 with a B.A. degree in Islamic History, specializing in Arabic.

relations.subject: David Dean Shulman
relations.evidence: His interest in Indian studies was inspired by a friend, the English economic historian Daniel Sperber

relations.subject: David Dean Shulman
relations.evidence: and later by the philologist, and expert in Semitic languages, Chaim Rabin.

relations.subject: David Dean Shulman

relations.subject: David Dean Shulman
relations.role: instructor, then lecturer, then full professor
relations.evidence: He was appointed instructor, then lecturer in the department of Indian Studies and Comparative Religion at Hebrew University, and became a full professor in 1985.

relations.subject: David Dean Shulman
relations.role: Renee Lang Professor of Humanistic Studies
relations.evidence: Presently he holds a chair as Renee Lang Professor of Humanistic Studies at the Hebrew University in Jerusalem.

relations.subject: David Dean Shulman
relations.evidence: He actively supports the Clay Sanskrit Library, for which he is preparing, with Yigal Bronner, a forthcoming volume.
